songs.title: Lanterns After Closing

lines.lyrics: The last tram folds its silver wings
A lantern warms the empty square
My cup keeps time in little rings
While velvet footsteps climb the stair

And let the quiet learn to sway
A small blue pause rides on the breeze
Then finds a gentle place to stay

songs.title: Maple Postcard

lines.lyrics: I tucked a leaf inside my case
And took the lane behind the mill

Along the shoulder of the hill

A tune the gravel knows by heart
I carry places I have been
In every chord before I start

songs.title: Neon Paper Planes

lines.lyrics: We fold the dusk in violet squares

On every fourth electric glow
Your signal crosses into mine
We let the bright horizon flow

songs.title: Courtyard Miniature

lines.lyrics: A sparrow maps the courtyard stones
With careful steps from shade to sun
The fountain answers silver tones
And counts the circles one by one
Each quiet phrase returns to rest
Like ribbons settling on a chair
A little cadence softly dressed
Leaves room for morning in the air
